**Clause-② reasoning (`no`, with the declared text cited):** supplying `org` pulls the runtime back to the declared contract. It widens nothing. objectstack `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts` L1578 lists the target scope as 「`ctx.user.*`, `ctx.org.*`, `ctx.recordId`, `ctx.selection`」, and L1016 names `ctx.org.id`.

**Premise re-read (objectui `main` `1dae95a`):** `useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx:739` supplies `activeOrganization: activeOrganization` and no `org`. `packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts:2239` reads `org: this.context.org ?? this.context.organization ?? {}`. So `${ctx.org.id}` resolves to empty, as the card says.

File-surface supplement to the claim `5866989749`, same session, same branch `claude/issue-10918-console-ctx-org`, at 2026-09-28T09:44Z. ⛔ Not a second claim.

- **Added:** `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` (the record page's own `ActionProvider` context, which today carries `record`, `objectName` and `user` and no `org`) and a test beside it. Also a shared location for the `org` projection helper if it has to leave `useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx` (inside `packages/app-shell/src` only).
- **Why this belongs to this claim:** the dev report on PR objectstack-ai/objectui#10945 measured `${ctx.org.id}` still resolving empty through the real `RecordDetailView`, with this branch's fix in place. The card's acceptance 1 is 「resolves to the active organization's id in the console」, and record pages are in the console. So without this, acceptance does not pass: a patch round, not a new card.
- **Serial check** (2026-09-28T09:40Z, objectui `main`): no open PR (14) and no claim on the lane's 18 `pm:dispatched` cards names `RecordDetailView.tsx`.

- **Form:** draft, base `main`, body first line `Fixes #10918`, and no other closing keyword in the body. 6 files, +414/−5, all inside the claim's file surface plus the supplement `5867455307` (`useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx`, `RecordDetailView.tsx`, the new helper `utils/actionContextOrg.ts`, two pins, `.changeset/10918-console-action-ctx-org.md`). `ActionRunner.ts` (held under objectui#10900) is not in the diff. Nothing under `content/docs/releases/`.
- **CI on the head `44de8b6b68`:** 43 check-runs, 40 `success` and 3 `skipped` (conditional jobs), none failed, `Spec Main Shape Gate` included. `mergeable_state: clean`. Governed-surface guard (`scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test`, 6 paths): NOT GOVERNED.
- **Contract review:** PASS at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` on this head, `5868090318`. It judges the changeset and the PR body against spec `ui/action.zod.ts` and the real `ActionRunner` read, and finds nothing WRONG.
- **The review's open flag (a third console provider?), measured by this seat on `origin/main`:** every `<ActionProvider` mount under `packages/` and `apps/`:
  - `ConsoleShell.tsx` (root, `context={runtime.actionProviderProps.context}`), and `useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx`, `DeclaredActionsBar.tsx`, `ObjectView.tsx` (each spreads `runtime.actionProviderProps`): covered by the runtime change.
  - `RecordDetailView.tsx`: covered by the patch round.
  - `apps/console/src/dev/DevRowActions.tsx`: the dev-only harness at `/dev/row-actions` (its header: "Not part of the product nav"). It renders static in-memory rows and no action reads `ctx.org`, so it is outside acceptance 1.
  - `packages/plugin-grid/demo/bulk-actions.tsx`: a package demo, not the console.
  So acceptance 1 (「resolves to the active organization's id in the console」) holds on every console surface that runs actions.
- **Spot readings (seat's own):** `actionContextOrg` returns `{ id, slug, name }` or `null`, and it is not re-exported from `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts`. With no organization, the pins assert an empty segment, never a literal `null`. Reverse verification in the report: each pin was red with its fix line deleted.
- **Clause-② `no` holds:** the change adds the spec-declared `org` key and widens no exported type, entry export or accept set. The undeclared `activeOrganization` key stays as it was.
- **Changeset re-read:** app-shell `patch`. Every claim matches the diff: two providers, `id`/`slug`/`name`, empty with no organization, `activeOrganization` unchanged, and no other key on the record page. The pending `.changeset/7997-detail-view-related-retired.md` also names `RecordDetailView.tsx`, but only for the retired `DetailView` `related` member, which this change does not touch.
- **Budget note:** `Bundle Analysis` and `Docs Route Eager Closure Check` are green. The console eager closure was at about 1.8 KB under its cap earlier today, and this adds a 33-line helper to app-shell. The next seat to touch the eager path should re-measure.
- **Findings:** routed, none filed. (1) `ActionRunner`'s `?? this.context.organization` fallback now has zero producers. That goes to seat 1 under objectui#10900, which holds the file, as a retirement candidate. (2) The undeclared `activeOrganization` key has 0 readers across objectui, cloud and objectstack. Retiring it is a separate call; noted in the PR body with carrier none.
- **Downstream:** cloud's welcome-page "invite members" CTA can target `/apps/cloud_control/sys_organization/record/${ctx.org.id}` once the tenant image carries this. The pin move rides on objectstack-ai/cloud#2441, and a pointer is posted there after merge.
